proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ α A H B C D hH hB hC hD hperp
  have py : ∀ X, X ∈ α → dist A X ^ 2 = dist A H ^ 2 + dist H X ^ 2 := by
    intro X hX
    have h0 : inner ℝ (A -ᵥ H) (H -ᵥ X) = 0 := hperp _ (AffineSubspace.vsub_mem_direction hH hX)
    rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V A X, dist_eq_norm_vsub V A H, dist_eq_norm_vsub V H X, ← vsub_add_vsub_cancel A H X,
      norm_add_sq_real, h0]
    ring
  have eq : ∀ X Y, X ∈ α → Y ∈ α → (dist A X = dist A Y ↔ dist H X = dist H Y) := by
    intro X Y hX hY
    rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (dist_nonneg (x := A) (y := X)) dist_nonneg, ← sq_eq_sq₀ (dist_nonneg (x := H) (y := X)) dist_nonneg, py X hX, py Y hY]
    constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
  rw [eq B C hB hC, eq C D hC hD]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (α : AffineSubspace ℝ P) (A H B C D : P), H ∈ α → B ∈ α → C ∈ α → D ∈ α → (∀ w ∈ α.direction, inner ℝ (A -ᵥ H) w = 0) → ((dist A B = dist A C ∧ dist A C = dist A D) ↔ (dist H B = dist H C ∧ dist H C = dist H D))
